newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Apr-Oct tax revenues up 14 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Indian Apr-Oct tax revenues up 14 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Indian Finance Ministry said on Wednesday that total tax collections between April and October were 152.57 billion rupees, up nearly 14 percent from 134.35 billion in the same period last year.

The ministry released a statement quoting Finance Minister P. Chidambaram as saying current trends indicated that the target for fiscal 1996/97 (April-March) would be exceeded and total tax revenues would be about 400 billion rupees.
It did not say what the target was.
